assertion.statement: Upgrade step: update Provider manifests to v2 provider package versions, which support both cluster-scoped and namespaced managed resources; existing cluster-scoped MRs keep working.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text gives no condition for who must upgrade providers beyond using Providers; which provider versions are in use is not stated.; consequence: Evidence says existing cluster-scoped MRs continue working unchanged and does not say what fails if the step is skipped.
